name: 100 Players Donate Game ⭐ [NEW UPDATE]
desc:
A game where you can enjoy the experience alongside nearly 100 players at the same time in a server full of fun, donations, and community vibes.

Discover the improved remake, featuring major enhancements in optimization, graphics quality, and much more.
Explore a completely revamped map, perfect for chatting, hanging out, and having fun with other players.
Fun is guaranteed!

📦 Create Your Own Stand: Customize it however you like, unlock new designs, and show off your unique style.

🧰 Exclusive Tools: Use the Control, Donation Sign, and more to enhance your experience.

💸 Epic Donation Animations: Enjoy amazing visual effects when receiving +1K and +10K Robux donations.

DISCLAIMER: This is the first official version, so there may still be some bugs or issues. If you encounter any problems, feel free to report them to our community. Your feedback is essential to help us improve!
Thanks for playing and being part of the experience. See you in the game! 🔥
